description: Use this when the user gives work on a team bid to someone, or takes it on: "give the Bristol bid call to Sam". The work is the bid call while a tender waits in Watching or Qualifying, or a sprint step, the next one unless named. Says who has it and whether they heard in Slack. When the person's role can't do it, the answer says who can: ask the user before choosing one. Needs a Tenda account and workspace. Not for ticking off a step (use update_bid_sprint) or the call itself (use record_bid_call). Example: {"tender_reference":"012345-2026","person":"Sam","task":"review"}

person.description: Who gets it: their name as the team knows them, e.g. "Sam" or "Sam Okafor", their email, or "me" for the user. Owners, admins and bid leads give out work; anyone can take work their role can do. Someone not in the workspace yet is invited from Today in the Tenda dashboard.

task.description: The work: "call" (the bid or no-bid call), or a sprint step: "decode", "assign", "draft", "review", "checks" or "submit". Leave it out for the tender's next piece of work.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: assign_task
title: Give out bid work
